title: The Many Faces of Magog Matrices
summary: Magog matrices, introduced by Holmlund and Striker in 2025, provide a matrix model for totally symmetric self-complementary plane partitions (TSSCPPs), as a natural analogue of alternating sign matrices (ASMs). In this paper, we develop several new combinatorial representations of magog matrices, mirroring classical representations of ASMs. Specifically, we define magog analogues of corner-sum matrices, height-function matrices, fully packed loop configurations, and vertex models, and establish explicit bijections among all of these objects.
